title: Germany's Twin Crisis: Political Fractures and an Economic Recovery That… · 14 Oct
keywords: Germany, AfD, coalition, CDU, SPD, Friedrich Merz, far right, firewall, economic recovery, inflation, Bundesbank, cost of living, eastern Germany, Saxony-Anhalt, EU, populism, energy prices, GDP forecast, trade unions, political instability
notes: Germany's governing coalition is struggling to contain the electoral rise of the far-right Alternative für Deutschland while simultaneously trying to convince voters that a genuine economic recovery is underway. The two crises are deeply intertwined: political instability is undermining confidence in democratic government at precisely the moment when citizens most need competent economic management. For Europe's largest economy, the stakes extend well beyond Berlin.
